reviewer: F-BD discovery owner; not repair implementer

result: No confirmed defect or blocker found

contracts.case: Default look, reference photo exists, with or without an old selected sheet
contracts.ui: Boolean(referencePhotoUrl) yields one reference regardless of faceState or old sheet
contracts.actual: buildCharacterSheetDraft sets liveFace=null and referencePhotoUrl from character; buildCharacterSheetPrompt selects photo only

contracts.case: Default look without photo, even with an old selected sheet
contracts.actual: Default draft does not use its old sheet; prompt receives neither face nor photo

contracts.case: Non-default look with a selected default sheet
contracts.ui: faceState=ready yields one reference and ignores original photo
contracts.actual: defaultLookFace and defaultLookFaceState use the same populatedDefaultSheet URL predicate; draft sets photo=null; prompt selects only default face sheet

contracts.case: Non-default look when default sheet is missing or generating
contracts.ui: Original faceBlocked condition still disables regeneration; helper preserves previous zero-reference behavior for these blocked states
contracts.actual: lookSheetFaceRefusal rejects starting generation while no selected default face exists

contracts.ui: undefined reference count keeps estimate pending
contracts.actual: imageCostHint explicitly returns estimate undefined before operation pricing for undefined count

contracts.case: Edit-only configured model and photographed default look
contracts.ui: One reference selects verified edit binding; issue=null and UI generation button is no longer disabled by mistaken generate-operation error
contracts.actual: Workflow passes prompt referenceUrls into generation; configuredOperationAvailable and configuredImageCost both select edit from count>0

testAssessment.reason: UI helper count is compared to independently constructed real draft plus prompt referenceUrls.length, followed by the production hint resolver. Explicit 100000/200000 micros assertions prevent equality-only tautology. Original helper reproduces the three photo/edit-only failures.
testAssessment.cases: Six new cases: photo with/without selected sheet, edit-only photo, no-photo old sheet, non-default face sheet, unloaded look
testAssessment.scope: Real production draft/prompt/hint modules with synthetic rows and price cards; no DB, provider, browser or persisted charge assertion
testAssessment.existingGreenEvidence: C-logs/reference-photo-green.json: five files, 37/37 passed; not repeated in this review

limitations: Static UI wiring confirms helper and disable conditions; no interactive browser exercise by this reviewer.
The helper does not change wallet capture, preflight or provider execution. No incorrect persisted charge was demonstrated before or after repair.
